description: This file defines the `DelinquencyBucketParseAndValidator` class responsible for validating and parsing JSON input related to delinquency bucket updates in a loan portfolio management system. It extracts and validates fields such as name and ranges from JSON commands, and constructs data objects for further processing.

classes.name: DelinquencyBucketParseAndValidator
classes.description: A Spring component class that extends `ParseAndValidator` to parse and validate JSON input for delinquency bucket updates. Provides validation logic for properties like name and range IDs, converting JSON data into domain objects.

methods.name: validateAndParseUpdate
methods.description: Validates and parses a JSON command to produce a DelinquencyBucketData object for update operations.
